title: Publish receiver-aware CCP specification
description: Publish the user-approved receiver-aware CCP policy revision with stable requirement IDs, explicit supersession and wire-activation gates, legal-plan and receiver capability constraints, and a conformance document. Harmonize affected normative summaries and correct relevant futurism claims about full-band/narrow-band LoRa and amateur/unlicensed operation. Runtime implementations and frozen legacy fixtures remain unchanged in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Policy and scoped experimental material reflect user approval; no density-driven remote channel/SF selection, impossible simultaneous single-radio reception or blanket FCC/ham approval; requirement-to-test scenarios and independent oracles specified; three independent documentary reviews and structural/link/diff checks pass.
